template.name: Step Stochastic Cross
template.notes: The ATR-based Step Stochastic is rebuilt as fast and slow EMA channels offset by 1x and 3x ATR(14), with a reclaim of the fast channel buying and losing the slow channel exiting; the multipliers are explicit fallbacks because KFast and KSlow carry no values. The price-unit stop/target and the buy/sell permission flags are not roster fields.
